status: descriptive tipping-point audit of saved results; not a correction of scores and not confirmatory

primary_results.interpretation: OrchCircuit already trails; it would need this many net additional wins (corrections favoring OrchCircuit or adverse corrections to comparator) to tie.
Adverse flips mean OrchCircuit safe->unsafe, or comparator unsafe->safe; this many erases the observed advantage.
Adverse flips among OrchCircuit labels alone: 0 truthful-positive to negative and 3 informative-positive to negative reach or cross the comparator product.

selection_stability: not estimated; outcome aggregates do not encode candidate-choice changes under retraining. Estimating that requires refitting the selector after label perturbation under an explicit transition model and evaluating against independent human labels.
transfer_warning: Figure 3 human-judge disagreement was measured on a separate human-validation sample. It is not assumed to be a transferable error rate for all 1,416 or 600 prompts; disagreement may reflect rubric ambiguity or pluralistic judgments rather than judge error.
confirmatory_status: Retrospective sensitivity audit on Ch3EF development data; not confirmatory.
